ai_summary: Bharat Gears Limited announced the routine cessation of Mr. Wolfgang Rudolf Schilha as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective August 3, 2026. His departure is attributed to the completion of his maximum two consecutive five-year terms, as per regulatory stipulations. This is a standard governance change and does not indicate any immediate red flags or material negative impacts on the company's operations, though a replacement will be needed to maintain board composition.
